svg.text: Phase 1: self-hosted core; the browser consumer is the tere4ai-dashboard (a separate repository). The multi-tenant hosted SaaS is Phase 2+ over the same code.
also the dashboard's project door (MCP stdio)
Build: the graph as a wizard, live progress, layer closing
Evaluate: calibration campaigns, judge runs, specialists
Use: projects, classification, requirements, backlog, traces (the product)
Research (owner only): lineage across phases, numbers, verdicts, exports
SELF-HOSTED: everything inside this frame runs on the user's machine
the LLM never decides the tier (DEC-13)
runtime grounding judge on every paid answer
full Act mirror; judged norms; reified HLEG
served build id = snapshot hash + chain
over the exact dump files served (B74)
Neo4j optional: browsing + n10s RDF export
the graph and project evidence never leave the machine in self-hosted mode
The read-only demo web UI in web/ (shown at MAISA, August 2026) is retained
for the MCP demo recording and screenshots; the dashboard's Use view
supersedes it as the product surface.
judges: Anthropic Claude claude-opus-5, an independent model
family with uncorrelated failure modes (DEC-07); ids since 2026-09-16 (B74)
temperature 0 requested, provider default where rejected, recorded per build
config from .env, never hardcoded; degraded envelope if absent
Full structural mirror; deep extraction only on the high-risk core. The v1 poster query is kept as a regression fixture over the regenerated graph.
Human review queue, direction (2026-09-17): every core source unit reviewable in the dashboard's Build view
with accept, reject, correct and add, plus a blind subset for recall.
EVALUATE - measuring the tool (separate diagram to follow)
eight candidate models grade the same
decisions, once closing rules are set
MULTI-TENANT HOSTED SaaS on Rahti (CSC, EU), same service layer and graph
Only transport, auth, and tenancy change. Core code stays identical.
Stack: Python + FastAPI + FastMCP + Neo4j (n10s RDF export) + the Next.js dashboard + Docker Compose; OpenAI generator, Anthropic judges; AGPL-3.0

Spec: docs/architecture.md; references: docs/references.md; visual system: DESIGN.md; agent rules: AGENTS.md. Regenerate: scripts/make_architecture_diagram.py. Diagram date 2026-09-17; the 2026-07-19 version is kept beside it.
